snippet.title: Don't Mind the Robots - Gameplay-Trailer
snippet.description:
Outsmart the robots in this strategic tower defense game. 

Wishlist and follow on Steam: steampowered.com/app/3656070

Build deadly mazes, upgrade your towers, and unlock powerful perks. Every decision matters as you adapt your defenses against increasingly stronger waves of AI-controlled opponents.
